drhp.business: OnEMI Technology Solutions ('Kissht') is a digital, AI/ML-driven lender to India's aspirational mass-market segment, providing unsecured personal loans and secured loans against property through its app. Loans are held on-book (via wholly-owned RBI middle-layer NBFC Si Creva Capital Services) and off-book (100-0 sourcing, co-lending and direct-assignment arrangements with 47 lenders). AUM was Rs 59,557.53 million with 11.17 million customers and 63.73 million registered users as of December 31, 2025.
drhp.end_markets: Mass-market retail borrowers (avg age 32, median CIBIL 746; 67.65% earning Rs 25k-75k/month; 63.38% in top-50 cities)|Small business / merchant borrowers
drhp.expansion: Uses net proceeds of the fresh issue (up to Rs 8,500 million) to augment the capital base of subsidiary Si Creva Capital Services to support the growth of its on-book lending business; continues scaling the digital lending platform and lender base rather than physical expansion.

sk.overview: India's digital financial services and NBFC-led retail lending sector serves a large, young, credit-underpenetrated mass market. Formalization (GST, JAM/India Stack, eKYC), rising smartphone/internet penetration and low data costs are enabling tech-led NBFCs and fintechs to underwrite and serve borrowers that conventional banks have historically underserved, particularly in unsecured personal loans and loan-against-property.

sk.structure: NBFCs hold ~18-19% of systemic credit and ~23% of the combined personal-loans and LAP market (FY2025), accounting for 25% of personal loans and 21% of LAP. Tech-led NBFCs/fintechs (Kissht, Moneyview, KreditBee, Fibe) capture share from cautious conventional lenders via digital-first, AI/ML …
